name: Mark of Hospitality Halfling
description:
Mark of Hospitality Halfling
Welcome, welcome! So good to see you again. Let me get your drink-blackroot tal with honey, yes? And then you have to listen to this story I've heard about the strange things going on in the Cogs.

features.name: Age
features.description: A halfling reaches adulthood at the age of 20 and generally lives into the middle of his or her second century.

features.name: Size
features.description: Halflings average about 3 feet tall and weigh about 40 pounds. Your size is Small.

features.name: Speed
features.description: Your base walking speed is 25 feet.

features.name: Lucky
features.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

features.name: Brave
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

features.name: Halfling Nimbleness
features.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

features.name: Ever Hospitable
features.description: When you make a Charisma (Persuasion) check or an ability check involving brewer's supplies or cook's utensils, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

features.name: Innkeeper's Magic
features.description: You know the prestidigitation cantrip. You can also cast the purify food and drink and unseen servant spells with this trait. Once you cast either spell with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

features.name: Spells of the Mark
features.description: If you have the Spellcasting or the Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Hospitality Spells table are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

features.name: Spell Level Spells
features.description:
1st goodberry, sleep

2nd aid, calm emotions

3rd create food and water, Leomund's tiny hut

4th aura of purity, Mordenkainen's private sanctum

5th hallow
